capabilities: Chat with notes using vault-wide semantic search
Proofread, rewrite, expand, summarize, translate and fact-check selected text
Count and list notes by folder, tag, property, words or date
Suggest tags and write frontmatter summaries
Run web and vault skills, including custom API skills
extras: MIT licensed. Local providers keep notes on the computer; with a cloud provider, each kind of content needs explicit consent before it is sent, and Vault Brain pauses. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions across a whole vault or have a model rewrite selected text, and cloud AI tools would send note content off the computer.

relations.evidence: PDFs can be indexed through the Text Extractor plugin.

requires.name: AI provider (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, Apple Intelligence or a cloud service)

summary: Private AI assistant that chats with your notes, runs text actions on selections, and searches the vault by meaning using local or cloud models.
